rulings.restated: Add gift.allowed over every confirmed gift entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The form says only "Other than by cash or check... see instructions. You must attach Form 8283 if over $500". The line 12 instructions are not in the pages given, and the per-entry value gift.allowed is not defined in the glossary, so its computation cannot be checked.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The gift collection holds noncash gifts only (forms/2025/gift.yaml, cited to i8283), and `gift.allowed` is each entry's deductible amount after its Form 8283 screens; cash and check gifts are the line 11 input. No change to the data.
